working_tree_note: The tested source and dependency files match source_commit; this evidence packet and documentation were added afterward.
case: ClickHouse nested values preserve the native JSON oracle in XLSX text cells
contract: The existing 16-shape nested contract uses native toTypeName() and toJSONString() results as type and value oracles.
For every nested shape, XLSX writes the result as a shared-string text cell whose content exactly matches the native JSON oracle.
JSON and CSV values remain equal to the native oracle; SQL literal, parameter-binding, and keyed-grid consumers refuse values without type metadata, and refusal leaves stored rows unchanged.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --offline --locked -p tablepro-driver-clickhouse --test integration nested_values::value_contract_nested_collections_keep_exact_json_and_refuse_lossy_consumers -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

clickhouse_driver_integration_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test --offline --locked -p tablepro-driver-clickhouse --test integration -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1
